passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: This is my classroom, and I like my classroom.
phrases.ko: 이곳은 나의 교실이고, 나는 나의 교실을 좋아해요.

phrases.en: My seat is near the window.
A clock is on the wall.
The room is bright, and we keep it quiet.
phrases.ko: 교실은 밝고, 우리는 교실을 조용히 해요.

phrases.en: I like the light from the window.
A clean board helps me see the lesson.
phrases.ko: 깨끗한 칠판은 내가 수업을 보도록 도와줘요.

phrases.en: The clock on the wall tells us the time.
phrases.ko: 벽에 있는 시계는 우리에게 시간을 알려 줘요.

phrases.en: A bright, quiet classroom is a good place to think.
phrases.ko: 밝고 조용한 교실은 생각하기에 좋은 곳이에요.

phrases.en: My seat is also next to Amy.
I like this classroom because it feels like ours.
phrases.ko: 이 교실은 우리 것 같아서 나는 좋아해요.

full_passage_spoken: This is my classroom, and I like my classroom. My seat is near the window. The board is clean. A clock is on the wall. The room is bright, and we keep it quiet. I like the light from the window. A clean board helps me see the lesson. The clock on the wall tells us the time. A bright, quiet classroom is a good place to think. My seat is also next to Amy. I like this classroom because it feels like ours.
